facts.fact: TechCabal reports the NIMC Act 2026, which replaced the 2007 Act, is law now; a NITDA spokesperson said it is operational and has been passed by the President.

TechCabal reports the NIMC Act 2026 reaffirms the NIN as the foundational identity under 'One Person, One Identity' and makes NIMC responsible for verifying electronic identities and a national public key infrastructure; document dated 2026-08-13, no event date given.
